subject: reacting to changes in dygraphs date_window

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: reacting to changes in dygraphs date_window
parts:
I'm using input$outputname_date_window to capture the date_window for a dygraphs plot as the user changes it. I have a second graph (a ggplot2 graph) 
that is updated when the date_window changes. This almost works fine, but the problem is that when the user slides the rangeSelector (or zooms with the mouse) it will update the date_window many times as they zoom and thus render the ggplot many many times. What I'd like it to do is wait for the user to finish zooming and then update the ggplot, but I haven't been able to figure out how to do it. Is this possible? Thanks in advance for the help. Much appreciated.
